sn45.6:1.2: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn45.6:1.4: katamaṃ nu kho bhante brahmacariyaṃ. katamaṃ brahmacariyapariyosānanti.
sn45.6:2.1: ayameva kho bhikkhu ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo brahmacariyaṃ. seyyathīdaṃ.
sn45.6:2.3: yo kho bhikkhu rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo
